items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: No mention of Big Chief Moore in relation to Peaches; Peaches is mentioned only by the Interviewer as Newton's partner.

ctx.x: Oh, yeh, he was a beautiful dancer. He used to have a partner with him by the name of Peaches. The act was called Pete and Peaches. They were great, they were headliners.
